text_en: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Any charge must be sustained by the evidence of two or three witnesses. ”
text_cn: 这是我第三次要到你们那里去。“无论什么事，凭两个或三个见证的口供，才得成立。”

text_en: I warned those who sinned previously and all the others, and I warn them now while absent, as I did when present on my second visit, that if I come again, I will not be lenient—
text_cn: 我第二次在你们那里时已经说过，如今不在的时候，再预先向那些以前犯了罪的，和其余的众人说：我若再来，必不宽容！

text_en: since you desire proof that Christ is speaking in me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful in you.
text_cn: 这是因为你们愿寻求基督在我内说话的证验，基督对你们并不是软弱的，相反，他在你们中是有能力的。

text_en: For he was crucified in weakness, but lives by the power of God. For we are weak in him, but in dealing with you we will live with him by the power of God.
text_cn: 他虽然由于软弱而被钉在十字架上，却由于天主的德能仍然活着；我们也是一样，虽然我们在他内也成了软弱的，但对于你们，我们却也要由于天主的德能同他一起活着。

text_en: Examine yourselves to see whether you are living in the faith. Test yourselves. Do you not realize that Jesus Christ is in you? —unless, indeed, you fail to meet the test!
text_cn: 你们该考查考查自己，是否仍站在信德上，你们要考验考验自己！难道你们自己认不出耶稣基督就在你们内吗？若不然，你们就是经不起考验的。

text_en: I hope you will find out that we have not failed.
text_cn: 但我希望你们认清我们并不是经不起考验的。

text_en: But we pray to God that you may not do anything wrong—not that we may appear to have met the test, but that you may do what is right, though we may seem to have failed.
text_cn: 我们祈求天主，使你们不作什么恶事，并不是为显明我们是经得起考验的，而是为叫你们行善，使我们好似成为经不起考验的一般。

text_en: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
text_cn: 因为我们并不能作什么来反对真理，只能拥护真理。

text_en: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. This is what we pray for, that you may become perfect.
text_cn: 因为几时我们软弱，而你们有能力，我们才喜欢；我们只求一件事：就是你们的成全。

text_en: So I write these things while I am away from you, so that when I come, I may not have to be severe in using the authority that the Lord has given me for building up and not for tearing down.
text_cn: 为此，当我还未来到的时候，先写了这些，免得我来到的时候，要照主所赐给我的，那原是为建树而不是为破坏的权柄，严厉处置你们。

text_en: Finally, brothers and sisters, farewell. Put things in order, listen to my appeal, agree with one another, live in peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you.
text_cn: 此外，弟兄们！你们要喜乐，要勉力成全，要服从劝勉，要同心合意，要彼此和睦：这样，仁爱与平安的天主必与你们同在。

text_en: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the saints greet you.
text_cn: 你们要以圣吻彼此问候；这里的众圣徒都问候你们。

text_en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
text_cn: 愿主耶稣基督的恩宠，和天主的爱情，以及圣神的相通，常与你们众人相偕。
